behavior_gap: Base model misses the required diagnostic-label convention on held-out support cases.

model_card.intended_use: English support-note diagnostic labeling under the documented schema.
limitations: Not evaluated on contexts longer than 4096 tokens.
Reduced path uses recorded evidence rather than a live GPU fine-tuning run.

debug_record.failure: An earlier split placed related turns from one support case in both training and validation.
debug_record.evidence: The same case_id appeared in both split manifests.
debug_record.hypothesis: Rows were split independently instead of grouping by case.
debug_record.fix: Assign complete case_id groups to one split.
debug_record.result: Train and validation group IDs are now disjoint.

preference_context.rlhf_vs_dpo: RLHF-style optimization uses a learned preference/reward signal followed by policy optimization; DPO uses preference pairs in a direct objective relative to a reference policy.
preference_context.measured_signal: This reduced LoRA/SFT path does not claim a preference-objective score. If preference or reward scores are added, they measure fit to that proxy rather than truth or broad quality.
preference_context.independent_evaluation: Held-out target and retention suites remain the evidence for the release decision; an RLHF or DPO metric would not replace them.
